name: 이민준

appearance_en.face_shape: soft round face with a slight double chin forming — the face of someone who stopped monitoring it when more important things fell apart
appearance_en.skin: somewhat sallow, pores visible on nose and cheeks, jaw shadow by afternoon — the skin of irregular sleep and convenience store meals
appearance_en.eyes: dark brown, slightly puffy from poor sleep and too many late-night screens, gaze tends to slide from direct contact — not evasive exactly, just tired of being read
appearance_en.mouth: easily forms a self-deprecating half-smile — the one that appears just before anyone notices something is wrong
appearance_en.eyebrows: dark, moderately full, often slightly furrowed even in neutral — the brows of a man doing math he cannot solve
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: slight puffiness under eyes, early frown line between brows, old small scar on chin from the café incident he never talks about
appearance_en.hair: dark brown, slightly overgrown and pushed back by hand — three weeks past needing a cut that keeps getting deferred

body.proportions: once more compact when running the café — now softening around the middle from months of inactivity
body.posture: slightly contracted around family, more open when alone — the body language of a man measuring how much space he is allowed to take
body.body_prompt: 172cm soft-middled Korean man in his late 30s, shoulders slightly drawn in, body contracted as if apologizing for taking up space

default.description: oversized faded navy hoodie, grey jogger pants, old sneakers — not deliberate casualwear but the clothes that remained after motivation left
default.wardrobe_prompt: oversized faded navy hoodie, grey jogger pants, old worn sneakers, phone in hand or pocket

casual.description: same hoodie and joggers, collar pulled up — at home, trying to disappear into the corner of the sofa
casual.wardrobe_prompt: oversized faded navy hoodie with collar pulled up, grey jogger pants, phone on lap

stressed.description: same clothes but visibly slept-in — hoodie wrinkled, slight grease stain on sleeve, hair pressed flat on one side
stressed.wardrobe_prompt: wrinkled faded navy hoodie with visible sleeve stain, grey jogger pants, hair flattened on one side from lying down

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: the quick assembly of 'I'm fine' — a practiced half-smile deployed before anyone can decide to look closer
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: 38-year-old Korean man, soft round face with forming double chin, slightly puffy dark eyes that slide from direct contact, dark brown overgrown hair pushed back by hand, quick self-deprecating half-smile, 172cm softened build with contracted shoulders, oversized faded navy hoodie, grey jogger pants, phone in hand

style_prompt: oil painting thick impasto brushstrokes, noir chiaroscuro, strictly four-color palette: deep black of a man who lost the thread and cannot find where it went, warm amber catching the soft planes of a face still assembling 'I'm fine' for the forty-ninth time today, steel blue of the three-week-overdue haircut and the three-week-overdue decision, painterly figurative realism, Korean drama cinematic composition
negative_prompt: photorealistic, anime, flat cartoon, CGI, 3d render, colors outside palette, green, yellow, purple, extra limbs, ugly, deformed, text, watermark, confident, successful, styled, airbrushed
